# netactuate_ssl_certificates (Data Source)

Reads SSL Certificates visible to the account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netactuate_ssl_certificates" "example" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `certificates` (List of Object) SSL certificates visible to the account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--certificates))
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
